name: STORM DRIVER
description: ⚡ STORM DRIVER 1.0.8 — Next-Gen Ultra-Low Thermal Vulkan Driver for ALL Qualcomm Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx/8xx / Snapdragon 845 up to 8 Elite) & ARM Mali/Immortalis GPUs. author: ReiKatari
